data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1492 recorded a net prior-year release in 2022 (approx. GBP 26.7m) driven primarily by favourable development on prior underwriting years (notably the 2021 year), partially offset by a small adverse movement on older years. The syndicate completed a legacy LPT for 2018 & prior which reduced the inflationary impact on prior reserves and 2020 & prior years are closing by RITC with a reported cumulative GAAP profit. No large quantified catastrophe impacts were reported on the syndicate's prior-year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: mitigated the impact of the current level of inflation on prior year reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount was derived from the year-of-account profit/(loss) breakdown (sum of non-current year underwriting year results) which is explicit in the report but represents an underwriting result (net economic impact) rather than a GROSS 'insurance liabilities' movement. No explicit separate 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was located; a gross claims development triangle is present and could be used to compute a gross PYD as an alternative. The prior_year_development_gbp_m therefore should be treated as a net/reconciliation-based figure (confidence high for the arithmetic but low for being a gross reserve movement). The report contains RITC and LPT transactions which can distort development comparisons.
